summary.text: Matt Ferry is the Democratic candidate for Tennessee House of Representatives District 48 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Bryan Terry.
Ballotpedia lists Ferry as the Democratic nominee against Terry in this district in 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024 as well.

paragraphs.text: Matt Ferry was born in Lebanon, Tennessee, and earned a bachelor's degree from Middle Tennessee State University.
He won the Democratic primary for Tennessee House District 48 in 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024, and lost each general election to incumbent Bryan Terry.
Ferry advanced from the Democratic primary again on August 6, 2026.
